response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), results AS (SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_gpu_difference, avg_remaining_storage / AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS storage_ratio, AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM site_averages) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_gpu_difference, storage_ratio FROM results WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
